newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ Treasurer Peters says RBNZ endorses his budget.
newsitem.headline: NZ Treasurer Peters says RBNZ endorses his budget.

text.p: The Reserve Bank's June Monetary Policy Statement endorsed the coalition government's budget, NZPA reported Treasurer Winston Peters as saying on Friday.
Earlier on Friday the RBNZ projected budget operating surpluses in the next two years that were lower than those forecast in the government's 1997/98 budget, delivered on Thursday.

The RBNZ's growth forecasts were much lower than Treasury's, which saw economic growth rising to 4.2 percent in the March 1999 year in annual average terms. The Reserve Bank projected it at 3.6 percent.
But Peters said in Christchurch the budget had the bank's backing.

"We are not being over-optimistic. The governor is a bit less optimistic than us but his figures are very very close and we regard what he said this morning as an endorsement. "He is actually talking about easing up, so there will actually be an environment conducive to more growth in our economy," Peters
